title: ✨ Forever [V3]
description: Originally thought to have been the outro for "Pressure", but it's unrelated entirely. Likely from early 2015 as Kanye was working closely with Rihanna and Keyon Christ on her album, as well as it being ripped from the same CD as "Pick Up Your Speed" - possibly a CD of references for Rihanna - when sent to Christina Aguilera. There are acapella and instrumental files from July 2015, but those were likely bounced to send to Darren King and other producers. The song title was confirmed when Keyon Christ referred to the snippet that leaked with Kanye vox as "#Forever". Keyon later released a version of the instrumental on SoundCloud.
